 ☐ Cache design

Which product page cache should I build?

❯ 1. CDN edge cache, 5-minute TTL
     About $300/month; prices can be up to 5 minutes stale after a change.
  2. Redis cache with purge on change
     About $900/month and 2 days of work; always fresh.
